name: flip.kz
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: www.flip.kz scores 57 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 36 are at risk, and 30 pass. Fix first: 70 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 70 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /contacts, /help, /actions/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 5 elements on /, /contacts, /help, for example .sAll > button. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 200. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 140 elements on /, /contacts, /help, for example .overflow-200.p300.hide-no-1200 and .overflow-200.p500.hide-no-1200. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 252 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 20 elements on /, /contacts, /help, for example .p500[href="https://www.flip.kz/user?enter"][rel="nofollow"] and .p300[rel="nofollow"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
Images below the first screen wait until they are needed
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
